arguments.code:
password = [p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='simple_note'][0]
access = apis.simple_note.login(username='siwhit@gmail.com', password=password)
print(access)

simple_note_token = access['access_token']
print('token set', bool(simple_note_token))

matches = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    res = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=simple_note_token, query='Bucket List Simple Note', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    # res expected list
    if not res:
        break
    for n in res:
        matches.append(n)
    page_index += 1

print('total_matches', len(matches))
print([(n['note_id'], n['title']) for n in matches])

new_line = '[ ] Taking a solo backpacking trip'

updated_content = old_content.replace(old_line, new_line)
print('changed:', updated_content != old_content)
# show the relevant lines around change
idx = updated_content.find(new_line)
print('index of new line:', idx)
print(updated_content[max(0, idx-80): idx+len(new_line)+80])

resp = apis.simple_note.update_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=simple_note_token, content=updated_content)
print('update response:', resp)
